design_name: Hard coverage-gated Caltech-to-OBELiX reverse ionic screen
status: post-outcome exploratory amendment frozen before gated run
reason_for_amendment: The parent run showed large ID improvement but harm when the Caltech expert was applied across the complete Q4, while the pre-outcome coverage audit showed that only 32 percent of Q4 lies inside the source coverage radius.
claim_guard: This gate was added after the ungated reverse-edge outcome was inspected. It can diagnose whether transfer is candidate-local and can define a method for later independent testing, but it is not confirmatory evidence.

gate.admit: nearest leakage-safe Caltech composition distance <= the 95th percentile of target-development leave-one-out nearest-neighbor distance

evaluation: reuse the frozen outcome-free OBELiX Q1 and Q4; report whole-scope and covered-Q4 effects
